biggest_catch: You only get paid if your friend opens a new Guaranty Bank consumer checking account AND, within 90 days, uses their Visa debit card at least once and has a recurring direct deposit or direct debit post via ACH. A friend who opens the account but never sets up ACH activity earns you nothing.
catches: New client's account must, within the 90-day qualifying period: (1) have the Visa debit card requested, activated, and used at least once (point-of-sale; ATM transactions do not count), and (2) have a recurring direct deposit or direct debit posted and settled via ACH. Zelle, Venmo, CashApp, and account-to-account transfers do NOT qualify.
The new account must stay open and active at least 30 days from opening and have a positive balance at bonus payment, or neither side is paid.
New client cannot have had a Guaranty Bank consumer checking account closed within the past 12 months; must be a Missouri resident to open an account.
Employees of Guaranty and affiliates are ineligible. Cannot be combined with other offers. Offer subject to change without notice.
Bonuses reported to the IRS as applicable; clients responsible for taxes.
Bank cannot disclose the friend's account activity to the referrer due to confidentiality — the friend must tell you they completed the requirements.

steps: Refer a new client to open any Guaranty Bank consumer checking account (subject to approval).
Your friend opens the account and, within 90 calendar days: activates and uses the Visa debit card at least once, and has a recurring direct deposit or direct debit post via ACH.
The new account stays open and active at least 30 days with a positive balance.
Guaranty Bank verifies the qualifying activity and credits a $50 bonus to both the new client's and your account within 30 calendar days after verification.
timing: Bonus credited within 30 calendar days after Guaranty Bank verifies all requirements (review begins once the new account has been open 30 days).
